scope: Insert one row of defaults, or resolve the implicit writable target slots in declaration order for an admitted VALUES or SELECT input.

defaults.role: One INSERT input with one row supplied by the target column defaults
defaults.structure: A final nullary value with no stored operands.
defaults.conditions: The owning INSERT requires an empty supplied column list and a resolved ordinary base identity.
defaults.meaning: For one new row, supply the target defaults for every writable column. The target applies generated values, affinity, constraints and triggers with the specified conflict policy.
defaults.externalInterpretation: Resolve the same absolute table, defaults, constraints and triggers at execution.
defaults.sql: Append DEFAULT VALUES to the INSERT head with no column list.

admission: With an ordinary input and no written column list, analyze pairs its result positions with the declared writable columns in declaration order. Generated and implicit fields are excluded.
Direct construction supplies the resolved list for VALUES and SELECT. The existing width, role and local-source guards still apply.
DEFAULT VALUES supplies no list, fixed one-row behavior and the admitted inherited, ABORT or IGNORE policy.
observations: Resolved absolute target and exact supplied column order
One default row with target affinity, generated values, trigger images and observed affected row count
Conflict behavior when a default duplicates an existing key, a separate target with a free default and complete rollback
Analysis of omitted target lists and explicit projections, parameters and source selection

finite.identity: Cross schemas and policies with default input once and the three finite row choices for each explicit input role.

exploration.structure: Vary input role, target schema and conflict policy, bound parameters, written values and source filter.

negative: An explicit target slot on a direct default input
DEFAULT VALUES with a written column list
An implicit write of the wrong width
A generated column explicitly given a value
faults: Change the absolute table of a default insert
Replace the requested conflict behavior in the INSERT head
open: Other conflict policies, virtual tables, WITH, UPSERT, RETURNING, and more general INSERT query inputs.
trust: The external declared table and data fixture
Pinned C observation of row and trigger effects
revisionNotes: Use the repository naming convention for the nullary default input. The admission, observations, finite identities and exploration remain the same.
